headline: An AI-made video of Rumpelstiltskin dancing, styled like an 1980s fantasy film, has become a widely shared internet meme.
score_reason: Lowered by 1: the clip dates from 27 Aug 2026 and the meme peaked before 8 Oct 2026; also a community-written source.
importance_line: Some viewers took a realistic AI clip for an old film, which shows how easily such video can pass as real; the view counts come from a community-edited reference site.
summary: Know Your Meme reports that an AI-generated clip posted on 27 Aug 2026 by Instagram pages including Stroinaya, showing a Rumpelstiltskin figure dancing in an 1980s fantasy-film style, became a meme in late September after being set to Riff Raff's song "TIP TOE WING IN MY JAWWDINZ", with one X post reaching 9.8 million views in five days. Some viewers believed it came from an old Russian film or the 1987 Rumpelstiltskin movie, although the site says the clip is confirmed to be AI.
notes: Meme coverage is new to our desk; the underlying clip is from 27 Aug 2026.
